entries.claim: The pinned digital body and resolved Qui vivis formula provide a derived comparison reading, including the substantive Sacratissimae opening against the selected printed Sanctissimae and the declared accidental differences.

RG 115 d prints the 17-word Qui vivis conclusion and Amen for an oration directed to the Son, supplying selected w024-w040. It expands the proper page's two-word cue; stress accents and the response's final period follow house presentation.

The Benziger proper page prints the 23-word Sanctissimae body and the two-word Qui vivis cue. The complete selected conclusion and response are not fully printed here; RG 115 d supplies the separately declared expansion.

locator.section: RG 480–481, 511 d/i, 513–514; Ordo Missae rubric and chant formula after the secrets

entries.claim: The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.
